items.prompt: What role can high-precision Decimal calculations play when reviewing this float-loop task?

options.text: They prove pow and repeated float multiplication have identical bits.
options.why: Mathematical agreement does not establish identical concrete float execution paths.

options.text: They silently replace the prescribed implementation and its output policy.
options.why: The public task still requires its stated float operation order.

options.text: An independent balance-model oracle, separate from exact float-path compliance.
options.why: Model arithmetic and the declared sequence of machine operations are different checks.
